Academic cap icons mark the 38 student chapters listed in the SAC roster, placed at their host institution's city and state. Click a cap for details; click another to switch. Scroll to zoom, drag to pan once zoomed in, and double-click to reset the view. Alaska and Hawaii are shown at a different scale in insets, as is standard for US maps.
